title: I added Pixal3D as a free tool to my game toolkit - no GPU needed (Pixal 3D is a free open source AI 3D)
author: ajdare
selftext: Pixal3D (free open source AI 3D generation model) I added it to Sorceress and anyone can use it for free (unlimited use until the servers melt) no GPU needed, no setup required - hope you guys like! Use it here -> [https://sorceress.games](https://sorceress.games)

comments.author: anaveragebest
comments.body: I honestly think one of the bigger improvements to rigging would be finer control over the fingers. the main issue (besides textures) with these models is that the rigging is totally broken related to fingers, so your models all walk with open hands or closed fists. need to be able to control those. but generating with closed fists is I guess preferred. the rest of this stuff doesn't look like something Tripo couldn't already do really.
